story: Four riders went clear straight from the gun on stage 1 of the Tour of Hainan, but they were caught with 90 km to go. Soon after, a three-man break formed and lasted until 25 km from the finish. Euskaltel then tried to split the peloton on the exposed oceanside roads, but without success. The run-in to the sprint was nervous, with two crashes in the final kilometres. Lotto-Intermarché did most of the work at the front inside the last 3 km to keep things under control. In the end, Dusan Rajovic won the bunch sprint ahead of Matteo Malucelli and Daniel Cavia.
